overview_description.description:
Med spas, wellness clinics, and aesthetics practices run on 5-10 disconnected tools that don't talk to each other. Decoda replaces all of them with a single AI-native platform — scheduling, charting, billing, payments, memberships, inventory, and patient communication in one place.

AI is built into every workflow: an AI front desk that answers calls and books patients 24/7, an ambient scribe that generates clinical notes in real time, and automated follow-ups that keep calendars full.

Live in 150+ clinics, processing $100M+ in annual transactions. Founded in 2023, backed by Y Combinator (S23) with $4.5M raised.
